title: Leo Music Studio v10.4.6 - 3D Acoustic Ambience Rooms, Live BPM & Musical Key Detector, Instant Track Share & Ultra-Smooth Lyrics
notes:
v10.4.6 Studio Experience Upgrade:
1. 4 STUDIO ACOUSTIC AMBIENCE ROOMS: Switch between Studio Master (Dry), 3D Concert Hall, Late Night Lo-Fi Warmth, and Bass Cathedral directly from the top header bar ('✦ Studio / Concert / Lo-Fi / Cathedral') or Settings.
2. REAL-TIME TRACK BPM & MUSICAL KEY DETECTOR: Displays live rhythmic BPM (e.g. 124 BPM), musical key scale (e.g. C Minor / G# Minor), and 320kbps lossless master verification inside the Acoustic & Lyrics Studio.
3. 1-CLICK NOW-PLAYING SHARE CARD & VERIFIED LYRICS SYNC: Copy a formatted track status card to share on WhatsApp/Discord with one click, plus enjoy 100% verified lyrics matching and sub-pixel 60Hz/120Hz teleprompter glide.
